name: Executive order of July 13, 1869 rescinding the Santee Sioux reserve between the Big Sioux and James rivers
promises: The President rescinded the executive order of March 20, 1867 and restored to the public domain the land between the Big Sioux and the James rivers, between the forty-fourth and forty-fifth parallels (Royce schedule).
landTaken: Royce records that the reserve was never occupied by the Santee Sioux before it was restored to the public domain by this order.
today: The Santee Sioux remained on the Niobrara reservation in Nebraska (Royce schedule).
